newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle not well tested - USDA.

text.p: Trade very slow in the Panhandle area Tuesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers not well tested and heifers steady in light test.
Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers. 1,700 head confirmed for week to date. Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1100 lbs 68.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 975-1050 lbs 68.00.
Confirmed - 300 Week Ago - 38,700 Year Ago - None
Wk to Date - 1,700 Week Ago - 60,100 Year Ago - 19,700
